label: GO step after a rewarded visit to S1 (first ~75 trials of episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1), and in every case where the previous state is known, that state was S1 (prev_state in {1,-1} keeps 97% recall; the missed ~20% are rel -3 GO steps where the window cut off the previous state). It is also strongly gated by episode time: rate rises up to trials 30-50, drops after 70, and is zero after ~90. Precision is only ~0.5: within this condition it is often silent during long steady runs of rewarded a1->S1 with S1 good. Magnitude is highest when the S1 reward was unexpected, i.e. a rare-transition reward after choosing a2 with S2 good (top examples are all a2 chooser, rare S1 reward); prev_common==0 holds 43% of mass with 26% of active steps. Silent after unrewarded trials and after S2 rewards. Uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
